implementation.classification: An owner edge is resolved iff its target handle matches a captured record sourceHandle; otherwise it is unresolved.
implementation.orderIndependence: The C++ disposition is derived during result serialization after all callbacks have populated the record list.
implementation.nullOwnerContract: DRW::NoHandle is zero. Null/zero owner handles have no owner edge; the adapter emits ownerHandle as null. The schema-3 validator accepts null or zero ownerHandle only when no owner edge exists.
implementation.graphNodeTargets: Owner resolution supports handle and block target nodes; the Python result validator recomputes the status against captured record handles and contains no legacy null-edge disposition branch.
